answer: Before first payout, the holder links an annual tax return under their number. Two verifiers match the signed receipt against the tax office record in a week; a number linked elsewhere, or no real income, closes both accounts. A real return costs two million rupiah in tax, so one holder files once while a thousand fakes need a thousand filings and two billion. The holder passes the walnut tree and basalt steps, leaving with an ember-red stamp.
